changelog:
temu-main-image-motion 0.1.1

- Initial launch: turn a Temu main image into a listing video using subtle product motions.
- New SKILL.md specifies input requirements, motion options, planning steps, payment workflow, and detailed process for generating the final video.
- Enforces non-invention of product details; only visible or stated info is used.
- Outlines free, non-billable shot plan and confirms approval and billing before video creation.
- Clarifies recovery, error handling, and execution strictly via the bundled MCP client.
summary: Turn one Temu main image into one Temu main image video for the listing video slot. The template one-shot keeps that photo as the first frame and returns one main image clip. Use it when Temu listing video work is product main image motion that stays one photo one clip.
